newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude up to $20.86 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude up to $20.86 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude climbed to an average of $20.86 per barrel on Sept 11, up from $20.75 the day before, a spokesman for the state-run Petroecuador oil company said Tuesday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The average price in August was $18.51 per barrel, up from $14.63 per barrel in August 1995.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
